name: Keep API contracts explicit and transport-safe
statement: Expose explicit request and response contracts, validate caller-controlled values at the boundary, and avoid leaking persistence, process, or framework-internal types through the API.
rationale: Stable transport contracts allow Quality Studio's API, Angular client, and external integrations to evolve independently while keeping trust-boundary validation visible.

goodExample.code:
app.MapPost("/runs", (StartReviewRequest request, ReviewJobService jobs, CancellationToken ct) =>
    jobs.EnqueueAsync(request.RepositoryId, request, ct));

history.change: Initial API-shape rule grounded in Quality Studio's request/response records and boundary validation.
